profiles.title: PWR-VCC
profiles.source: flag glyph convention of the compiler (the host places a power flag by kind+net, never from a library profile). NOT re-measured this batch: carried over from blocklib/specs/ch340_serial.library.json (its last two profiles, the flag-family convention), whose own source records the live-host measurement of 2026-10-03 for the family: the Power flag placed at (300,300) with net VCC resolves to the host symbol 'Power-5V', has its connection point AT the origin (PinLength 5) and its glyph 4.5..10.5 units ABOVE it (bbox [294.5,304.5,305.5,310.5]); the Ground flag at (600,300) has its connection point at the origin (PinLength 10) and its bars 9.5..19.5 units BELOW it ([589.5,280.5,610.5,290.5]) - pit 43's two families. Evidence (as cited by ch340_serial.library.json, not re-taken here): outputs/099/libprobe/pins_flag_vcc.json + 08_geometry_probe.json
